Kupfer & Sohn, RK Traders, and Ökoring folders had no new invoices beyond what was already parsed. One unfiled invoice found in supplier-bills root folder from a new, not-yet-tracked supplier 'Smart Elite Dienstleistungen GmbH' (Rechnung Nr. 4837, 08.06.2026, GANESH BHEL / CHING'S products, net EUR 518.14, gross EUR 554.41) — flagged for manual filing decision, not yet added to any supplier JSON. Additionally added Smart Elite Dienstleistungen GmbH as a 7th tracked supplier (1 invoice, net EUR 518.14). Built out new delivery-platform revenue tracking (wolt.json, uber_eats.json, lieferando.json) covering weekly/period summaries for June-July 2026.
